title: Schumann — Album für die Jugend, Op. 68 No. 1 (Mélodie)

reference.license: CC BY-SA 2.5 (Mutopia 2007, Philippe Hezaine after Peters). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: 4/4, C major. One \repeat volta 2 over the first 4 bars, then 16 linear bars (printed 20; performed 24).

repeatsUnfoldedInMidi is TRUE here and false everywhere else in the corpus. The .ly carries a second \score block with \unfoldRepeats feeding \midi, so the reference MIDI is the 24-bar PERFORMANCE (verified: MIDI bars 1-4 are note-for-note identical to 5-8). The scorer therefore aligns the MIDI against the OMR's performed measure list instead of the srcIndex-deduped printed list, which makes a dropped repeat show up as four bars of missing notes rather than as a bar count off by four.

No printed metronome mark — the heading is the word 'pas vite'. expectedTempo is therefore a wide band and tempoInRange is a diagnostic here, not a gate. This piece is the control for 'the play-along gate does not depend on a printed BPM'.
Staff index is not hand across editions; the Mutopia MIDI track order is the hand oracle.
Fingering digits are printed on most notes; Audiveris reads dense fingerings as dynamics or tuplets.
pdf.sha256 pins the Mutopia letter PDF (1 page). Do not embed document UUIDs.
No ornament signs, so expectedExtraNotes is 0 and every extra note is a real reading error.
